claim: To use a DNS name that is easier to remember, you associate a custom domain name with the DNS name of the Application Load Balancer, for example with an Amazon Route 53 alias record that points to the load balancer.
question: How do you point your own domain name at an Application Load Balancer?

evidence.quote: If you'd prefer to use a DNS name that is easier to remember, you can create a custom domain name and associate it with the DNS name for your Application Load Balancer.
For example, if you use Amazon Route 53 as your DNS service, you create an alias record that points to your Application Load Balancer.
